title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Maya Chen
description:
This PR adds a set of RAG-focused developer quickstarts and example agents that demonstrate tool-calling and structured outputs, and wires them into the docs site. Motivation: provide engineers with drop-in templates and runnable examples to accelerate building retrieval-augmented agents using Redwood's API and tool-calling primitives.

What's included:
- docs/quickstarts/rag-agent.md: conceptual walkthrough and step-by-step quickstart (Python + TypeScript snippets).
- examples/rag-agent/python/tool_calling_example.py: toy agent showing tool registration, schema-based tool responses, and streaming generation.
- examples/rag-agent/ts/tool_calling_example.ts: equivalent TypeScript example using the TS SDK and structured output parsing.
- docs/snippets/agents/rag-template.json: opinionated RAG agent template (prompt structure, retrieval config, cache hints) for teams to copy.
- docs/site config updates: side-nav entries and redirects for the new quickstart pages.
- small copy edits in docs/concepts/agents.md to reference tool-calling and RAG templates.

Testing performed:
- Ran examples smoke tests against local dev stack and hosted API (using test API key).
- Docs site build locally and verified navigation entries and code rendering.
- Unit tests for the Python example helper utilities added.

Checklist:
- [x] Quickstart content drafted and reviewed by product.
- [x] Examples runnable with provided README and environment variables.
- [x] Docs site nav and SEO-friendly title/description added.
- [x] CI checks green.
- [x] Reviewed and approved by reviewers.

Notes for reviewers and maintainers:
- The rag-template.json is intentionally small and prescriptive; teams that need non-default retrieval configs should copy it into their repo and tweak retrieval/embedding settings.
- The examples assume the presence of a simple tool registry API (examples include a lightweight in-memory tool adapter). We intentionally keep the adapter minimal to focus on tool-calling flow; a follow-up PR will add a more production-ready tool adapter and RBAC notes.
- No runtime code paths in the serving runtime were changed; this is docs/examples only.

Related PRs/Artifacts:
- Related quickstart PRs: see earlier RAG docs PRs (pr-53888, pr-53421) for prior iteration and feedback that motivated this update.

Release notes:
- Added RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples to developer docs and examples folder. Engineers can now reference runnable templates for RAG + tool-calling flows.
